blocks.zh: 濾膜滅菌
blocks.en: Sterilization of Filters

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解濾膜滅菌 (Filter Sterilization) 在除菌過濾製程中的關鍵角色，以及滅菌失敗對無菌濾液保證的影響
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of filter sterilization in sterilizing filtration, and how a sterilization failure affects sterile filtrate assurance

blocks.zh: 掌握三大滅菌方法 — 蒸汽滅菌 (Steam)、輻射滅菌 (Irradiation)、氣體滅菌 (Gas) — 的原理、適用範圍及操作注意事項
blocks.en: Master the principles, scope of application and operating precautions of the three sterilization methods: steam, irradiation and gas

blocks.zh: 學會區分 Autoclave（高壓滅菌鍋）與 SIP（就地滅菌）的操作差異及各自的關鍵控制點
blocks.en: Learn to distinguish the operational differences and the respective critical control points of autoclave and SIP (sterilize-in-place) sterilization

blocks.zh: 了解再滅菌 (Resterilization) 的限制條件與驗證要求，以及濾膜重複使用的風險評估考量
blocks.en: Understand the restrictions and validation requirements for resterilization, and the risk assessment considerations for filter reuse

blocks.zh: 8.0 Sterilization of Filters 濾膜滅菌（總論）
blocks.en: 8.0 Sterilization of Filters (General)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Filtration Assembly Sterility（過濾組件無菌性）：除菌過濾不僅要求濾膜本身具備截留細菌的能力，整個過濾組件（包括殼體、管路、接頭）都必須處於無菌狀態。特別強調的是 filtrate side（濾液側），因為這是產品已通過除菌濾膜後的「乾淨面」，任何污染都直接影響最終產品的無菌保證。
blocks.en: Filtration Assembly Sterility: Sterilizing filtration requires not only that the filter membrane itself can retain bacteria, but also that the entire filtration assembly (housing, tubing and connections) is sterile. The filtrate side is especially emphasized, because it is the "clean side" where the product has already passed through the sterilizing-grade filter, and any contamination there directly affects the sterility assurance of the final product.

blocks.zh: Sterility Goal（滅菌目標）：指滅菌製程需要達成的微生物殺滅水準。對於蒸汽滅菌，通常要達到 10-6 SAL (Sterility Assurance Level)，即一百萬個滅菌單元中僅容許一個不合格。
blocks.en: Sterility Goal: The level of microbial kill that the sterilization process must achieve. For steam sterilization, this is normally a 10-6 SAL (Sterility Assurance Level), meaning only one non-sterile unit is permitted per one million sterilized units.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在做手術前，不只要消毒手術刀，還要消毒整個手術台面、器械盤、和所有接觸到傷口的器具。除菌過濾也一樣 — 光是濾膜無菌不夠，整個「濾液側管路」都要滅菌乾淨，就像手術室的無菌區域概念。如果你只消毒了手術刀卻忘了消毒器械盤，病人依然會感染。
blocks.en: Imagine that before surgery you must disinfect not only the scalpel, but also the whole operating table, the instrument tray and every item that touches the wound. Sterilizing filtration works the same way: a sterile membrane alone is not enough, and the entire "filtrate-side flow path" must be sterilized, just like the sterile field in an operating room. If you disinfect only the scalpel and forget the instrument tray, the patient can still get an infection.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本節開宗明義點出了一個核心矛盾：滅菌必須徹底有效，但又不能損傷濾膜。這就是為什麼必須遵循製造商的建議 — 溫度、壓力、時間的組合都需要在「殺滅微生物」和「保護濾膜材料」之間取得平衡。
blocks.en: This section opens by pointing out a core tension: sterilization must be thorough and effective, yet it must not damage the filter. This is why the manufacturer's recommendations must be followed: the combination of temperature, pressure and time must balance "killing microorganisms" against "protecting the membrane material".

blocks.zh: 此外，當滅菌製程非自動化時，TR26 建議在滅菌後進行完整性測試 (Integrity Test)。這呼應了 Section 7.0 的 PUPSIT（使用前滅菌後完整性測試）概念 — 滅菌過程本身可能導致濾膜損傷，完整性測試就是確認損傷是否發生的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: In addition, when the sterilization process is not automated, TR26 recommends performing an integrity test after sterilization. This echoes the PUPSIT (pre-use post-sterilization integrity test, as discussed in Section 7.0) concept: the sterilization process itself can damage the membrane, and the integrity test is the last line of defense for confirming whether damage has occurred.

blocks.zh: 決策層級回顧 Decision Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌濾液保證 Sterile Filtrate Assurance
blocks.en: 1. Sterile Filtrate Assurance

blocks.zh: 2. 產品品質 / CQAs
blocks.en: 2. Product quality / CQAs

blocks.zh: 3. 製程穩健性 & 商業效率
blocks.en: 3. Process robustness & commercial efficiency

blocks.zh: 濾膜滅菌直接影響第一層級 — 如果過濾組件未被正確滅菌，無菌濾液保證就無從談起。這就是為什麼滅菌程序必須經過適當的確認 (qualification) 而非僅靠經驗操作。
blocks.en: Filter sterilization directly affects the first tier: if the filtration assembly is not properly sterilized, there can be no sterile filtrate assurance. This is why the sterilization procedure must be properly qualified rather than relying on operator experience alone.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR26 特別強調「filtrate side」的無菌性，而非整個組件的無菌性？請從產品流向的角度思考。
blocks.en: Why does TR26 specifically emphasize the sterility of the "filtrate side" rather than of the entire assembly? Think about it from the perspective of product flow.

blocks.zh: 如果滅菌製程是全自動化的，是否仍需進行滅菌後的完整性測試？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the sterilization process is fully automated, is a post-sterilization integrity test still required? Why?

blocks.zh: 製造商建議的滅菌參數與使用者自行開發的參數，哪個應作為起點？為什麼？
blocks.en: Should the manufacturer's recommended sterilization parameters or user-developed parameters be the starting point? Why?

blocks.zh: 8.1 Steam Sterilization 蒸汽滅菌
blocks.en: 8.1 Steam Sterilization

blocks.zh: Steam Sterilization（蒸汽滅菌）：利用高壓飽和蒸汽（通常 121°C 以上）殺滅微生物的方法，是製藥業最廣泛使用的滅菌方式。分為兩種執行方式：
blocks.en: Steam Sterilization: A method that uses pressurized saturated steam (typically above 121°C) to kill microorganisms; it is the most widely used sterilization method in the pharmaceutical industry. It is carried out in two ways:

blocks.zh: Autoclave（高壓滅菌鍋）：將物品放入封閉腔體中滅菌，適用於可拆卸的過濾組件
blocks.en: Autoclave: Items are placed in a closed chamber for sterilization; suitable for detachable filter assemblies

blocks.zh: SIP - Sterilize-in-Place（就地滅菌）：蒸汽直接通入已安裝的管路系統進行滅菌，適用於固定式不鏽鋼殼體系統
blocks.en: SIP (Sterilize-in-Place): Steam is introduced directly into the installed piping system; suitable for fixed stainless steel housing systems

blocks.zh: Biological Indicator, BI（生物指示劑）：含有已知數量高耐熱芽孢的載體，用來驗證滅菌條件是否足以殺滅微生物。BI 可放置在濾膜核心或摺疊濾材內部，確認蒸汽是否真正穿透到最難達到的位置。
blocks.en: Biological Indicator (BI): A carrier containing a known number of highly heat-resistant spores, used to verify that the sterilization conditions are sufficient to kill microorganisms. A BI can be placed inside the filter core or within the pleated media to confirm that steam actually penetrates to the most difficult-to-reach location.

blocks.zh: 10-6 SAL（無菌保證水準）：表示每一百萬個滅菌單元中，允許不超過一個單元殘存活微生物的機率。這是藥典和法規對最終滅菌產品的標準要求。
blocks.en: 10-6 SAL (Sterility Assurance Level): The probability of no more than one viable microorganism surviving per one million sterilized units. This is the standard requirement of pharmacopoeias and regulations for terminally sterilized products.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌就像用高壓蒸鍋消毒嬰兒奶瓶 — 單純的熱水不夠，必須是加壓的飽和蒸汽才能確保每個角落都達到殺菌溫度。而 BI 就像在蒸鍋最裡面、最難被蒸汽觸及的角落放一張「溫度試紙」— 如果那裡的微生物都被殺死了，就能確信其他地方也沒問題。
blocks.en: Steam sterilization is like disinfecting a baby bottle in a pressure steamer: plain hot water is not enough, and it must be pressurized saturated steam to make sure every corner reaches the lethal temperature. A BI is like placing a "temperature test strip" in the innermost corner that steam reaches least easily: if the microorganisms there are killed, you can be confident that everywhere else is fine too.

blocks.zh: TR26 強調驗證研究必須同時包含兩項確認：
blocks.en: TR26 stresses that the validation study must confirm both of the following:

blocks.zh: 滅菌有效性：透過 BI 確認達到 10-6 SAL
blocks.en: Sterilization effectiveness: Confirm through BIs that a 10-6 SAL is achieved

blocks.zh: 濾膜完整性：透過滅菌後的完整性測試確認濾膜未損傷
blocks.en: Filter integrity: Confirm through a post-sterilization integrity test that the membrane has not been damaged

blocks.zh: 這兩項缺一不可。即使 BI 證明滅菌成功，如果濾膜被蒸汽壓力或溫度損傷而失去完整性，整個除菌過濾製程仍然無效。
blocks.en: Neither can be omitted. Even if the BI proves that sterilization succeeded, if the membrane is damaged by steam pressure or temperature and loses its integrity, the whole sterilizing filtration process is still invalid.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 BI 要放在「濾膜核心」或「摺疊濾材內部」，而不是放在殼體外部或管路上？
blocks.en: Why should the BI be placed in the "filter core" or "within the pleated media" rather than on the outside of the housing or on the tubing?

blocks.zh: Autoclave 和 SIP 各適用於什麼類型的過濾系統？在 CDMO 多產品廠房中，哪種更常見？
blocks.en: What type of filtration system is each of autoclave and SIP suited to? Which is more common in a multi-product CDMO facility?

blocks.zh: 8.1.1 Autoclave Sterilization 高壓滅菌鍋滅菌
blocks.en: 8.1.1 Autoclave Sterilization

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在極端條件下（如高溫滅菌）從濾膜材料中萃取出的化學物質。溫度越高、時間越長，可萃取物越多。這些物質可能影響產品品質，因此滅菌溫度不宜過高。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemicals extracted from the filter material under extreme conditions (such as high-temperature sterilization). The higher the temperature and the longer the time, the more extractables. These substances may affect product quality, so the sterilization temperature should not be too high.

blocks.zh: Microbial Barrier（微生物屏障）：滅菌後用來包裹濾膜的保護層，必須達到「擋住微生物但允許空氣和蒸汽通過」的雙重要求。常見的材料包括滅菌用包裝紙或透氣型滅菌袋。
blocks.en: Microbial Barrier: The protective layer used to wrap the filter after sterilization; it must meet the dual requirement of "blocking microorganisms while allowing air and steam to pass". Common materials include sterilization wrap paper or breathable sterilization pouches.

blocks.zh: Differential Pressure（壓差）：濾膜上下游的壓力差。在高溫滅菌期間，如果進出口被封閉，內部壓力無法平衡，可能導致濾膜結構性損傷甚至破裂。
blocks.en: Differential Pressure: The pressure difference between the upstream and downstream sides of the membrane. During high-temperature sterilization, if the inlet and outlet are sealed, the internal pressure cannot equalize, which may cause structural damage or even rupture of the membrane.

blocks.zh: Air Removal（排氣）：Autoclave 滅菌的核心挑戰。空氣是蒸汽穿透的最大障礙 — 如果殘留空氣形成「氣穴」，該區域將無法達到滅菌溫度，造成「冷點」(cold spot)。
blocks.en: Air Removal: The core challenge of autoclave sterilization. Air is the biggest barrier to steam penetration: if residual air forms "air pockets", those areas cannot reach the sterilization temperature and become "cold spots".

blocks.zh: Autoclave 滅菌中的排氣問題，就像用電鍋蒸包子 — 如果蒸籠裡的冷空氣沒有排乾淨，包子表面看起來「蒸好了」，但內部其實還沒熟。蒸汽必須完全取代空氣，才能均勻傳熱。所以 Autoclave 會用「真空-蒸汽交替循環」(vacuum and steam purge cycles) 來反覆抽真空再灌蒸汽，就像反覆打開蒸籠蓋讓冷空氣排出一樣。
blocks.en: The air removal problem in autoclave sterilization is like steaming buns in a rice cooker: if the cold air in the steamer is not fully purged, the buns look "done" on the outside but are still raw inside. Steam must completely displace the air to transfer heat evenly. That is why an autoclave uses "alternating vacuum and steam purge cycles", repeatedly drawing a vacuum and then admitting steam, much like repeatedly lifting the steamer lid to let the cold air out.

blocks.zh: 這一小節列出了多項 Autoclave 操作的實務細節，每一項都是常見偏差的來源：
blocks.en: This subsection lists a number of practical autoclave operating details, each of which is a common source of deviations:

blocks.zh: 進出口必須保持開放：封閉的管路會產生壓差，可能在降溫階段撕裂濾膜
blocks.en: Inlet and outlet must remain open: Closed lines create a pressure differential and may tear the membrane during the cool-down phase

blocks.zh: 包裝材料要適量：太多層包裝會阻礙蒸汽穿透，但太少又無法在滅菌後維持無菌狀態
blocks.en: Use an appropriate amount of wrapping material: Too many layers hinder steam penetration, but too few cannot maintain sterility after sterilization

blocks.zh: 接頭和軟管需要支撐：高溫下塑料軟化，重力可能使膠囊濾器的進出口變形
blocks.en: Connectors and hoses need support: Plastics soften at high temperature, and gravity may deform the inlet and outlet of capsule filters

blocks.zh: 滅菌後立即取出：長時間暴露在高溫乾空氣中會造成氧化損傷
blocks.en: Remove promptly after sterilization: Prolonged exposure to hot, dry air causes oxidative damage

blocks.zh: 考慮慢排氣循環：避免降溫階段的快速壓力變化對濾膜的衝擊
blocks.en: Consider a slow exhaust cycle: Avoids the impact of rapid pressure changes on the membrane during the cool-down phase

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的工廠同時使用 10" 和 30" 膠囊濾器，兩種尺寸可以放在同一個 Autoclave 批次中滅菌嗎？
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your facility uses both 10" and 30" capsule filters. Can both sizes be sterilized in the same autoclave load?

blocks.zh: 答案是要非常謹慎。30" 大型濾器的排氣和蒸汽穿透需求與 10" 小型濾器不同。如果使用相同的 prevacuum 參數，大型濾器內部可能殘留冷空氣，導致滅菌不完全。建議依據濾器尺寸分別驗證滅菌參數，或至少以「最大裝載量 / 最難滅菌組合」作為最差情境進行驗證。
blocks.en: The answer is: with great caution. The air removal and steam penetration requirements of a large 30" filter differ from those of a small 10" filter. If the same prevacuum parameters are used, cold air may remain inside the large filter, resulting in incomplete sterilization. It is advisable to validate the sterilization parameters separately for each filter size, or at least to validate using the "maximum load / most difficult-to-sterilize configuration" as the worst case.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR26 建議滅菌溫度不超過製造商的上限（通常 130-134°C）？超溫會帶來哪些風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR26 recommend that the sterilization temperature not exceed the manufacturer's upper limit (typically 130-134°C)? What risks does exceeding it bring?

blocks.zh: 「進出口保持開放」和「微生物屏障保護」看似矛盾，實務上如何同時滿足這兩個要求？
blocks.en: "Keeping the inlet and outlet open" and "protecting the microbial barrier" seem contradictory. In practice, how can both requirements be met at the same time?

blocks.zh: 如果在 Autoclave 滅菌後立即進行完整性測試，濾膜不需要乾燥。為什麼？（提示：思考完整性測試的潤濕要求）
blocks.en: If an integrity test is performed immediately after autoclave sterilization, the membrane does not need to be dried. Why? (Hint: think about the wetting requirement of the integrity test.)

blocks.zh: 大型過濾組件為何需要特別調整 prevacuum 階段？這與「冷點」(cold spot) 有什麼關聯？
blocks.en: Why do large filtration assemblies need a specially adjusted prevacuum phase? How is this related to "cold spots"?

blocks.zh: 8.1.2 Sterilize-in-Place 就地滅菌 (SIP)
blocks.en: 8.1.2 Sterilize-in-Place (SIP)

blocks.zh: SIP - Sterilize-in-Place（就地滅菌）：蒸汽直接通入已安裝在製程管路上的過濾殼體，無需拆卸即可進行滅菌。通常用於不鏽鋼殼體的固定式過濾系統。
blocks.en: SIP (Sterilize-in-Place): Steam is introduced directly into a filter housing that is installed on the process line, so sterilization can be performed without disassembly. It is typically used for fixed filtration systems with stainless steel housings.

blocks.zh: Forward Flow（正向流）：蒸汽沿著正常製程方向（從上游到下游）通入。這是保護濕潤濾膜的關鍵 — 讓濾膜上的殘留液體在蒸汽壓力升高前先蒸發掉。
blocks.en: Forward Flow: Steam is introduced in the normal process direction (from upstream to downstream). This is key to protecting a wetted membrane: it lets residual liquid on the membrane evaporate before the steam pressure rises.

blocks.zh: Reverse Pressure Differential（反向壓差）：當下游壓力高於上游壓力時發生。在冷卻階段，如果上游先冷卻（蒸汽冷凝產生真空），而濾膜核心仍保持較高壓力，就會形成反向壓差，可能反向撕裂濾膜。
blocks.en: Reverse Pressure Differential: Occurs when the downstream pressure is higher than the upstream pressure. During cool-down, if the upstream side cools first (steam condensation creates a vacuum) while the filter core is still at a higher pressure, a reverse pressure differential forms and may tear the membrane in the reverse direction.

blocks.zh: Thermal Shock（熱衝擊）：溫度的急劇變化（例如液態冷卻水接觸高溫濾膜）可能導致材料結構性損傷。因此建議使用氣體輔助冷卻 (gas-assisted cooling)，讓溫度緩慢下降。
blocks.en: Thermal Shock: A sudden change in temperature (for example, liquid cooling water contacting a hot filter) may cause structural damage to the material. Gas-assisted cooling is therefore recommended so that the temperature falls slowly.

blocks.zh: SIP 的操作就像在家裡幫暖氣管路做維護 — 你不能直接把滾燙的蒸汽灌進冷管路（會像把冷玻璃杯放進滾水一樣碎裂），而是要慢慢加溫。同樣地，冷卻時也不能用冰水去沖 — 必須讓它像關火後的爐子一樣自然降溫（或用風扇吹涼，即氣體輔助冷卻），而不是潑水降溫。
blocks.en: Operating SIP is like maintaining the heating pipes at home: you cannot pour scalding steam straight into cold pipes (it would shatter them, like putting a cold glass into boiling water), so you must heat up slowly. Likewise, you cannot flush with ice water during cooling. It must be allowed to cool down like a stove after the flame is turned off (or be blown cool with a fan, which is gas-assisted cooling), rather than being doused with water.

blocks.zh: SIP 有幾個容易被忽視的關鍵操作要點：
blocks.en: SIP has several key operating points that are easily overlooked:

blocks.zh: 材料限制：聚丙烯 (PP) 和聚酯 (PET) 殼體的一次性膠囊濾器不能進行 SIP，除非是耐高溫的特殊聚合物如聚醚亞胺 (PEI)
blocks.en: Material limitations: Single-use capsule filters with polypropylene (PP) and polyester (PET) housings cannot undergo SIP, unless they are made of a special high-temperature polymer such as polyetherimide (PEI)

blocks.zh: 壓力監控：上下游都必須安裝壓力錶，因為壓差是 SIP 過程中濾膜損傷的首要風險
blocks.en: Pressure monitoring: Pressure gauges must be installed both upstream and downstream, because differential pressure is the primary risk of membrane damage during SIP

blocks.zh: 緩慢升壓：蒸汽必須以低壓正向緩慢引入，先排除濾膜中殘留的液體
blocks.en: Slow pressurization: Steam must be introduced slowly in the forward direction at low pressure to first drive out residual liquid from the membrane

blocks.zh: 雙側進蒸汽：可以考慮從濾膜兩側同時引入蒸汽，消除跨膜壓差
blocks.en: Steam from both sides: Consider introducing steam from both sides of the membrane at the same time to eliminate the transmembrane pressure differential

blocks.zh: 冷卻階段維持正壓：必須用空氣或惰性氣體維持正壓，避免形成反向壓差
blocks.en: Maintain positive pressure during cooling: Positive pressure must be maintained with air or inert gas to avoid forming a reverse pressure differential

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你的客戶要求使用 SIP 除菌過濾系統。你需要評估以下問題：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Your client requires a SIP sterilizing filtration system. You need to evaluate the following questions:

blocks.zh: 殼體材質是否能承受 1-2 bar 蒸汽壓力？（不鏽鋼殼體通常沒問題，但高分子殼體需要確認）
blocks.en: Can the housing material withstand 1-2 bar steam pressure? (Stainless steel housings are normally fine, but polymer housings need to be confirmed)

blocks.zh: 管路設計是否允許冷凝水排放？（如果冷凝水無法排出，會造成積水阻礙蒸汽穿透）
blocks.en: Does the piping design allow condensate drainage? (If condensate cannot be drained, standing water will hinder steam penetration)

blocks.zh: 冷卻系統是否配置了氣體輔助冷卻？（如果只有水冷卻，需要評估熱衝擊風險）
blocks.en: Is the cooling system equipped with gas-assisted cooling? (If only water cooling is available, the thermal shock risk needs to be evaluated)

blocks.zh: PLC 控制系統是否能監控上下游壓差並在超限時自動中止？
blocks.en: Can the PLC control system monitor the upstream/downstream differential pressure and abort automatically when the limit is exceeded?

blocks.zh: 這些設計考量在專案初期就要確定，因為它們影響管路佈局、儀表配置和自動化程式設計。
blocks.en: These design considerations must be settled at the start of the project, because they affect the piping layout, instrumentation and automation programming.

blocks.zh: 為什麼一次性聚丙烯膠囊濾器不能進行 SIP？如果強行執行會發生什麼？
blocks.en: Why can a single-use polypropylene capsule filter not undergo SIP? What happens if it is done anyway?

blocks.zh: TR26 提到可以從濾膜兩側同時引入蒸汽。這種設計在管路規劃上需要額外增加哪些設備？
blocks.en: TR26 mentions that steam can be introduced from both sides of the membrane at the same time. What additional equipment does this design require in the piping layout?

blocks.zh: 冷卻階段的「反向壓差」是如何形成的？請用溫度-壓力的關係來解釋。
blocks.en: How does the "reverse pressure differential" during the cooling phase form? Explain using the relationship between temperature and pressure.

blocks.zh: 8.2 Irradiation Sterilization 輻射滅菌
blocks.en: 8.2 Irradiation Sterilization

blocks.zh: Irradiation Sterilization（輻射滅菌）：利用高能量輻射（伽瑪射線或 X 射線）破壞微生物的 DNA 來達到滅菌效果。這是一種「穿透式」滅菌，輻射可以直接穿過包裝材料，因此濾膜可以在最終包裝狀態下進行滅菌。
blocks.en: Irradiation Sterilization: Uses high-energy radiation (gamma rays or X-rays) to destroy the DNA of microorganisms and achieve sterilization. It is a "penetrating" sterilization: the radiation passes directly through the packaging, so filters can be sterilized in their final packaging.

blocks.zh: Bioburden and Dosimetry Approach（生物負荷與劑量測定法）：先測量產品上的初始微生物量（bioburden），再計算需要多少輻射劑量（dosimetry）才能達到所需的無菌保證水準。這與蒸汽滅菌使用 BI 的方法不同。
blocks.en: Bioburden and Dosimetry Approach: The initial microbial load on the product (bioburden) is measured first, and then the radiation dose (dosimetry) needed to achieve the required sterility assurance level is calculated. This differs from the BI approach used for steam sterilization.

blocks.zh: ISO-11137：輻射滅菌的國際標準，規範了劑量建立、劑量審核和常規滅菌的要求。
blocks.en: ISO 11137: The international standard for radiation sterilization, which specifies the requirements for dose establishment, dose audit and routine sterilization.

blocks.zh: Shelf Life（保存期限）：輻射滅菌的濾膜通常有較短的保存期限，因為輻射會持續引起聚合物降解，即使在滅菌完成後。
blocks.en: Shelf Life: Irradiated filters usually have a shorter shelf life, because radiation continues to cause polymer degradation even after sterilization is complete.

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌就像把食物送進機場的 X 光機 — 射線直接穿透包裝殺死病菌，食物本身不需要被拆封或加熱。好處是「乾式」滅菌（不需要蒸汽或水），壞處是某些材料會被輻射「曬傷」— 就像皮膚被紫外線曬傷後會變脆弱，某些塑膠材料被伽瑪射線照射後也會劣化，而且這種劣化隨時間累積，所以保存期限有限。
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization is like sending food through an airport X-ray machine: the rays pass straight through the packaging and kill the germs, and the food itself does not need to be unwrapped or heated. The advantage is that it is a "dry" sterilization (no steam or water needed). The disadvantage is that some materials get "sunburned" by radiation: just as skin becomes fragile after sunburn from ultraviolet light, some plastics also degrade after exposure to gamma rays, and this degradation accumulates over time, so the shelf life is limited.

blocks.zh: TR26 點出了一個極其重要的交叉滅菌風險：
blocks.en: TR26 points out an extremely important cross-sterilization risk:

blocks.zh: 這表示已經過輻射滅菌的濾膜，不應該再進行蒸汽滅菌。輻射已經使聚合物結構弱化，蒸汽的高溫高壓會進一步加速降解，導致：
blocks.en: This means that a filter that has already been irradiated should not be steam sterilized again. Radiation has already weakened the polymer structure, and the high temperature and pressure of steam will further accelerate degradation, resulting in:

blocks.zh: 可萃取物和可溶出物 (E&L) 大幅增加 — 影響產品品質
blocks.en: A significant increase in extractables and leachables (E&L), affecting product quality

blocks.zh: 濾膜物理完整性喪失 — 影響無菌保證
blocks.en: Loss of the membrane's physical integrity, affecting sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，這意味著如果你購買的是「已輻射滅菌」的即用型濾器，千萬不要在使用前再 Autoclave 一次。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, this means that if you buy "pre-irradiated" ready-to-use filters, you must never autoclave them again before use.

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌使用「生物負荷+劑量測定」方法驗證，而蒸汽滅菌使用「生物指示劑」方法驗證。這兩種方法的核心差異是什麼？
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization is validated with the "bioburden + dosimetry" approach, while steam sterilization is validated with the "biological indicator" approach. What is the core difference between these two approaches?

blocks.zh: 為什麼輻射滅菌的濾膜保存期限通常比蒸汽滅菌的短？這與輻射對聚合物的效應有何關係？
blocks.en: Why is the shelf life of irradiated filters usually shorter than that of steam-sterilized filters? How is this related to the effect of radiation on polymers?

blocks.zh: CDMO 購買了一批輻射預滅菌的膠囊濾器，操作員誤將其放入 Autoclave 再次滅菌。這批濾器還能使用嗎？應該怎麼處理？
blocks.en: A CDMO purchased a batch of pre-irradiated capsule filters, and an operator mistakenly placed them in an autoclave for another sterilization. Can these filters still be used? How should they be handled?

blocks.zh: 8.3 Gas Sterilization 氣體滅菌
blocks.en: 8.3 Gas Sterilization

blocks.zh: Ethylene Oxide, EO / EtO（環氧乙烷）：一種具有強烈殺菌能力的氣體，可在較低溫度下殺滅微生物，適用於不耐高溫的材料。但它是一種已知的致癌物，且會在材料中殘留，產生有害副產物。
blocks.en: Ethylene Oxide (EO / EtO): A gas with strong microbicidal power that can kill microorganisms at relatively low temperatures, making it suitable for materials that cannot tolerate high heat. However, it is a known carcinogen and leaves residues in materials, creating harmful by-products.

blocks.zh: Ethylene Chlorohydrin（氯乙醇）和 Ethylene Glycol（乙二醇）：EO 與濾膜材料或包裝中的氯化物和水分反應產生的副產物。這些殘留物具有毒性，必須在滅菌後通過充分的除氣 (aeration) 過程去除。
blocks.en: Ethylene Chlorohydrin and Ethylene Glycol: By-products formed when EO reacts with chlorides and moisture in the filter material or packaging. These residues are toxic and must be removed after sterilization through an adequate aeration process.

blocks.zh: Bacillus atrophaeus（萎縮芽孢桿菌）：EO 滅菌驗證專用的生物指示劑菌種（過去也稱為 B. subtilis var. niger）。之所以不用數學模型建立殺滅動力學，是因為 EO 滅菌的多參數交互作用過於複雜，尚無可靠的預測公式。
blocks.en: Bacillus atrophaeus: The biological indicator organism dedicated to EO sterilization validation (formerly also called B. subtilis var. niger). Kill kinetics are not established with a mathematical model because the interaction of multiple parameters in EO sterilization is too complex, and no reliable predictive formula exists.

blocks.zh: EO 氣體滅菌就像家裡用蟑螂燻蒸劑 — 密封空間裡釋放有毒氣體，殺死所有蟲子（微生物），但之後必須徹底通風（除氣），否則殘留的毒氣會傷害住在裡面的人（患者）。而且，燻蒸劑很難穿透到折疊的衣服深處 — 這就是為什麼 EO 不適合用在摺疊式濾器 (pleated filters) 上，因為氣體無法有效穿透多層摺疊的濾膜結構。
blocks.en: EO gas sterilization is like using a cockroach fumigant at home: toxic gas is released in a sealed space and kills all the pests (microorganisms), but the space must then be thoroughly ventilated (aeration), otherwise the residual toxic gas will harm the people (patients) who live there. Moreover, fumigant has difficulty penetrating deep into folded clothes, which is why EO is not suitable for pleated filters: the gas cannot effectively penetrate the multi-layer pleated membrane structure.

blocks.zh: TR26 對 EO 滅菌的態度相當謹慎，基本上將其限制在「非常小的圓盤式濾器」。主要原因：
blocks.en: TR26 takes a rather cautious attitude toward EO sterilization and basically restricts it to "very small disc filters". The main reasons are:

blocks.zh: 穿透性問題：EO 氣體難以穿透摺疊式濾膜的複雜結構
blocks.en: Penetration problem: EO gas has difficulty penetrating the complex structure of pleated membranes

blocks.zh: 殘留物風險：毒性副產物必須被徹底去除，但濾膜內部的去除效率難以驗證
blocks.en: Residue risk: Toxic by-products must be thoroughly removed, but the removal efficiency inside the membrane is difficult to verify

blocks.zh: 環境與安全：EO 是致癌物，全球監管趨勢正在限制其使用
blocks.en: Environment and safety: EO is a carcinogen, and the global regulatory trend is to restrict its use

blocks.zh: 缺乏數學模型：與蒸汽滅菌不同，EO 的五個參數之間的殺菌交互作用無法用公式預測，只能依賴 BI 來驗證
blocks.en: Lack of a mathematical model: Unlike steam sterilization, the microbicidal interaction among the five EO parameters cannot be predicted by a formula and can only be verified with BIs

blocks.zh: 在現代製藥生產中，EO 滅菌的濾器已經非常罕見。大多數應用已被輻射預滅菌或蒸汽滅菌取代。
blocks.en: In modern pharmaceutical manufacturing, EO-sterilized filters are already very rare. Most applications have been replaced by irradiation pre-sterilization or steam sterilization.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EO 滅菌只適用於小型圓盤式濾器而不適用於大型摺疊式濾器？請從「氣體穿透」和「殘留物去除」兩個角度分析。
blocks.en: Why is EO sterilization suitable only for small disc filters and not for large pleated filters? Analyze from two angles: "gas penetration" and "residue removal".

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌可以用 D 值和 Z 值來計算所需的滅菌時間，但 EO 滅菌卻無法這樣做。為什麼？這對驗證策略有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Steam sterilization can use D-values and Z-values to calculate the required sterilization time, but EO sterilization cannot. Why? What impact does this have on the validation strategy?

blocks.zh: 如果法規要求完全禁止 EO 的使用，需要 EO 滅菌的小型濾器可以改用什麼替代滅菌方法？
blocks.en: If regulations completely prohibited the use of EO, what alternative sterilization methods could be used for the small filters that need EO sterilization?

blocks.zh: 8.4 Resterilization of Filters 濾膜再滅菌
blocks.en: 8.4 Resterilization of Filters

blocks.zh: Resterilization（再滅菌）：在同一個濾膜上進行多次滅菌循環。這可能發生在兩種情境下：
blocks.en: Resterilization: Performing multiple sterilization cycles on the same filter. This may occur in two situations:

blocks.zh: 製程需求：例如 SIP 滅菌後因故未能立即開始過濾，需要再次 SIP
blocks.en: Process need: For example, after SIP, filtration could not start immediately for some reason, and SIP needs to be repeated

blocks.zh: 多批次使用：一支濾器在一批次使用完畢後，清洗並再次滅菌後用於下一批次
blocks.en: Multi-batch use: A filter is used for one batch, then cleaned and resterilized for use in the next batch

blocks.zh: Cumulative Dosage Effects（累積劑量效應）：多次輻射滅菌的劑量會累加，即使每次劑量在材料耐受範圍內，累積後的總劑量可能超出材料承受極限。
blocks.en: Cumulative Dosage Effects: The doses from multiple irradiation sterilizations add up. Even if each dose is within the material's tolerance, the cumulative total dose may exceed the material's limit.

blocks.zh: Single-Lot Use（單批次使用原則）：TR26 的預設立場是除菌濾膜在處理完一個批次後即應丟棄。重複使用需要額外的驗證。
blocks.en: Single-Lot Use: TR26's default position is that a sterilizing filter should be discarded after processing one batch. Reuse requires additional validation.

blocks.zh: 再滅菌就像把同一件衣服反覆用高溫烘乾機烘乾 — 每烘一次，衣服都會稍微縮水、褪色、變脆。蒸汽滅菌對濾膜的影響也是累積性的：第一次可能看不出差別，但第 10 次、第 20 次之後，濾膜的機械強度、化學穩定性和可萃取物特性都可能發生變化。所以製造商會標明「最大允許滅菌次數」，就像衣服洗標上的「最高洗滌溫度」。
blocks.en: Resterilization is like drying the same garment over and over in a hot dryer: each cycle shrinks, fades and embrittles it a little more. The effect of steam sterilization on a filter is likewise cumulative: the first cycle may show no difference, but after the 10th or 20th cycle, the membrane's mechanical strength, chemical stability and extractables profile may change. This is why manufacturers specify a "maximum number of permitted sterilization cycles", like the "maximum washing temperature" on a garment care label.

blocks.zh: 本小節涉及三個層次的風險管理：
blocks.en: This subsection involves three levels of risk management:

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法的累積效應：
blocks.en: Cumulative effects of the sterilization method:

blocks.zh: 蒸汽可多次使用（有上限）
blocks.en: Steam can be used multiple times (up to a limit)

blocks.zh: 輻射不建議多次使用（累積劑量）
blocks.en: Irradiation is not recommended for multiple use (cumulative dose)

blocks.zh: 交叉滅菌（輻射+蒸汽）通常不可行
blocks.en: Cross-sterilization (irradiation + steam) is generally not feasible

blocks.zh: 再滅菌驗證要求：必須驗證最大允許循環次數下的完整性、細菌截留能力和可萃取物水準
blocks.en: Resterilization validation requirements: Integrity, bacterial retention capability and extractables levels must be validated at the maximum permitted number of cycles

blocks.zh: 重複使用的額外驗證：如果濾膜在多個批次間重複使用，驗證範圍必須擴大到包含清洗驗證、最大批次數下的完整性測試和細菌截留研究
blocks.en: Additional validation for reuse: If a filter is reused across multiple batches, the validation scope must be extended to include cleaning validation, integrity testing at the maximum number of batches, and bacterial retention studies

blocks.zh: 在決策層級中，再滅菌和重複使用的經濟效益屬於最低層級（商業與效率）。如果再滅菌有任何可能影響無菌濾液保證（最高層級），則不應進行。
blocks.en: In the decision hierarchy, the economic benefit of resterilization and reuse belongs to the lowest tier (commercial and efficiency). If resterilization could in any way affect sterile filtrate assurance (the highest tier), it should not be done.

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：客戶要求將一支 30" 不鏽鋼殼體除菌濾器在 5 個連續批次中重複使用，以降低過濾耗材成本。作為製程工程師，你需要怎麼評估？
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: A client asks to reuse one 30" stainless steel housing sterilizing filter across 5 consecutive batches to reduce filtration consumable costs. As the process engineer, how should you evaluate this?

blocks.zh: 確認濾膜製造商標示的最大 SIP 循環次數（例如 50 次），確保 5 次使用加上必要的 SIP 在此範圍內
blocks.en: Confirm the maximum number of SIP cycles stated by the filter manufacturer (for example, 50) and ensure that 5 uses plus the necessary SIP cycles fall within this range

blocks.zh: 驗證計畫必須使用「最大使用次數」（5 批次 + 相應次數的 SIP 和清洗）作為驗證條件
blocks.en: The validation plan must use the "maximum number of uses" (5 batches plus the corresponding number of SIP cycles and cleaning cycles) as the validation condition

blocks.zh: 每次使用後必須進行完整性測試，且須通過才能進入下一批次
blocks.en: An integrity test must be performed after each use, and it must pass before proceeding to the next batch

blocks.zh: 清洗驗證必須證明產品殘留不會影響下一批次的品質
blocks.en: Cleaning validation must demonstrate that product residues will not affect the quality of the next batch

blocks.zh: 細菌截留研究必須在最大使用次數後進行
blocks.en: Bacterial retention studies must be performed after the maximum number of uses

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：對於 CDMO 多產品廠房，濾器重複使用還涉及交叉污染風險 — 不同產品之間絕對不應共用除菌濾器。
blocks.en: Important reminder: in a multi-product CDMO facility, filter reuse also involves cross-contamination risk. A sterilizing filter should never be shared between different products.

blocks.zh: TR26 預設立場是「除菌濾膜在處理完一個批次後即應丟棄」。在什麼情況下重複使用可以被合理化 (justified)？
blocks.en: TR26's default position is that "a sterilizing filter should be discarded after processing one batch". Under what circumstances can reuse be justified?

blocks.zh: 為什麼多次輻射滅菌通常不可行，但多次蒸汽滅菌在一定範圍內是可以接受的？兩者對材料的影響機制有何不同？
blocks.en: Why is multiple irradiation sterilization generally not feasible, while multiple steam sterilization is acceptable within certain limits? How do the mechanisms of their effects on the material differ?

blocks.zh: 如果一個濾器經過 Autoclave 滅菌後完整性測試失敗，但之前的滅菌次數仍在製造商標示的上限內，可能的原因有哪些？
blocks.en: If a filter fails the integrity test after autoclave sterilization, but the number of previous sterilizations is still within the manufacturer's stated limit, what are the possible causes?

blocks.zh: 從決策層級的角度分析：重複使用濾器帶來的成本節約，是否足以合理化額外的驗證負擔和潛在的品質風險？
blocks.en: From the perspective of the decision hierarchy: are the cost savings from reusing filters sufficient to justify the additional validation burden and the potential quality risk?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 濾膜滅菌的核心目標：在確保達到無菌保證水準（10-6 SAL）的同時，不損傷濾膜的物理完整性和化學穩定性。這是一個需要平衡的「雙重要求」。
blocks.en: Core objective of filter sterilization: Achieve the sterility assurance level (10-6 SAL) without damaging the physical integrity and chemical stability of the filter. This is a "dual requirement" that must be balanced.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌（Section 8.1）是最廣泛使用的方法，分為 Autoclave（適用於可拆卸組件）和 SIP（適用於固定式系統）。關鍵控制點包括：排氣（Autoclave）、壓差控制（SIP）、緩慢升溫降溫、以及冷卻階段維持正壓。
blocks.en: Steam sterilization (Section 8.1) is the most widely used method and is divided into autoclave (for detachable assemblies) and SIP (for fixed systems). Key control points include: air removal (autoclave), differential pressure control (SIP), slow heating and cooling, and maintaining positive pressure during the cooling phase.

blocks.zh: 輻射滅菌（Section 8.2）提供乾式無殘留的滅菌方式，但受限於材料相容性和保存期限。最關鍵的警告：已輻射滅菌的濾膜不應再進行蒸汽滅菌，否則可萃取物增加且可能喪失完整性。
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization (Section 8.2) offers a dry, residue-free method of sterilization, but is limited by material compatibility and shelf life. The most critical warning: a filter that has been irradiated should not be steam sterilized again, otherwise extractables increase and integrity may be lost.

blocks.zh: 氣體滅菌（Section 8.3）以 EO 為主，但因氣體穿透困難和毒性殘留問題，僅限用於小型圓盤式濾器。驗證必須依賴生物指示劑（B. atrophaeus），因為缺乏可靠的數學殺菌模型。
blocks.en: Gas sterilization (Section 8.3) is mainly EO, but because of the difficulty of gas penetration and toxic residues, it is limited to small disc filters. Validation must rely on biological indicators (B. atrophaeus), because there is no reliable mathematical kill model.

blocks.zh: 再滅菌（Section 8.4）需注意累積效應 — 蒸汽滅菌可在製造商限制內多次執行，但輻射和交叉滅菌通常不可行。濾膜的預設使用原則是「單批次即丟棄」，重複使用需要全面的額外驗證。
blocks.en: Resterilization (Section 8.4) requires attention to cumulative effects: steam sterilization can be performed multiple times within the manufacturer's limits, but irradiation and cross-sterilization are generally not feasible. The default principle for filters is "discard after a single batch", and reuse requires comprehensive additional validation.

blocks.zh: 決策層級提醒：無論選擇哪種滅菌方法，無菌濾液保證 (Sterile Filtrate Assurance) 永遠是第一優先。任何可能危及無菌保證的成本節約措施都應該被拒絕。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy reminder: Whichever sterilization method is chosen, Sterile Filtrate Assurance is always the first priority. Any cost-saving measure that could jeopardize sterility assurance should be rejected.
